novaMid.text: Bolt, I pulled the city ledger. Nova Plaza didn't fail — the HOA fined every resident until they LEFT, then kept charging the empty houses.
So where'd the Keystone Core end up?
Wired straight into the FineTree, powering the fine-meter. Grindstone's using a galaxy-saving artifact to send late notices. Let's go unplug it.

glaciusMid.text: These pods... there are people in them, Sprocket. Thousands. All mid-subscription.
ForeverYou™. You pay to be frozen; thawing is a PREMIUM tier. The Core's running the freezer. Pull it and the whole vault wakes up.
Then that's exactly what we're doing. Every one of them goes home.

verdantMid.text: The mega-harvester's been leaking coolant for six years. The whole ecosystem mutated AROUND it — that's why everything glows. And talks. And unionizes.
Fused into the harvester's dead reactor. The corn's been guarding it. Honestly? They've done a better job than OmniScrap ever did.

novaLate.text: Update: the FineTree just issued YOU a fine. 'Unauthorized heroism, second offense.' There's a late fee on it. It's dated next week.
They pre-fined you. Honestly? That's the most confidence anyone's ever shown in us.

glaciusLate.text: When the vault thaws... where do all these people GO? Their homes got repossessed while they were frozen.
Filed that under 'problems for after we win'. It's a big file, Bolt. It's basically the whole cabinet.

verdantLate.text: The corn offered me a union card. Local 404. Dental. Sunlight clause. A DIGNITY rider, Bolt.
You're a robot. You don't have teeth.
It's about the PRINCIPLE of the teeth.

novaHolo.text: The mechanic, slumming it in my FAILURES. Nova Plaza was a rounding error. A TASTEFUL one.
He's watching us through the ad-drones. Smile, Bolt, you're depreciating on camera.

glaciusHolo.text: Cold enough for you? I could unfreeze this whole facility with one click. I simply choose not to. That's POWER, boy.
That's not power. That's just being a jerk with admin access.

l1_glitch.text: Bolt. Hypothetical. If a robot had a mandatory remote-shutdown clause buried in his firmware, would that change how you— NEW TOPIC. Great dunes.
I said LOOK AT THE DUNES, Bolt. They're doing dune stuff. Nature is healing.

l1_vista.text: Look at it. The whole planet's a landfill and it's still home. And I'm just... the guy who fixes junk nobody wanted.
You fixed ME. Day one. Bent antenna, refund-bin firmware, 'DEFECTIVE' stamped right on the box. You could've stripped me for parts.
And now I'm parts with OPINIONS. That's craftsmanship, junk boy. Own it.

l2_holo1.text: The mechanic. Enjoying my resort? Every deck chair is monetized. This hologram has a sponsor. YOU have a sponsor — you just haven't been invoiced yet.
Do bring the toaster to Core Foundry. And ask him about Clause 44 on the way. Watch the little eye twitch.
My eye does not TWITCH. It BUFFERS. Totally different failure mode.
A typo. Probably. Look, a waterfall!

l2_glambot.text: CUT! Cut cut cut— you just DELETED my co-host! Do you know what that does to my engagement?!
...It tripled it. It TRIPLED it. I love you. I'm keeping you.
You're not going to, like... avenge him?
Sweetie. I'm a STAR, not a sequel hook. OmniScrap has been scripting my personality for six seasons. Consider me DEFECTED. Call me GLAMBOT PRIME — I'll be your eye in the sky.
I hate how much I respect this.

l3_holo2.text: Welcome to headquarters, mechanic. Marble floors. Forty thousand subscription tiers paid for them. VOLUNTARILY. Remember that before you judge me.
Lobby's nice. The murder robots undercut it a little.
Security is a premium feature. You triggered the free trial.

l3_vent.text: PLOT TWIST, darling! That crusher corridor is rated for zero survivals, so I jammed a cooling vent open for you. Updrafts are SO cinematic.
Tactical support from an influencer. This war is deeply strange.
Thanks, GLAMBOT. Weirdly reliable of you.

l1_row.text: Rusty's Row. Every time OmniScrap repossesses a house, the family ends up here. It was three shacks when I was a kid.
It is now forty-one shacks, a water tower, and a working barter economy based on fuses. I ran the census while you were being wistful.
Well, if it isn't the Bolt boy. Heard they took your garage. Welcome to the club, hon — dues are zero and the roof leaks.
I'm getting it back, Mama Gasket. All of it. Everybody's.
That's what your father said. Difference is, you brought a mallet and a robot with a mouth on him. I like your odds better.

l1_mast.text: This mast was OmniScrap's billing antenna. Somebody's re-aimed it. I'm picking up... skate wheels? And a crash-test dummy doing play-by-play.
Out here? Who'd be broadcasting from past the Slag Flats?
Unknown. The signal's too thin to lock from Scrapheap. But whoever it is just called OmniScrap 'a subscription to disappointment', so I've decided we're friends.

l2_camp.text: Tents. Ore carts. This place wasn't always a resort.
Rustvane Mining Co-op. Worker-owned for sixty years. OmniScrap couldn't buy the mine, so they bought the river — then billed the miners for 'ambient moisture'.
The Co-op became 'Guest Experience Staff'. Same people, new lanyards. The uniform rental comes out of their wages. It is more than their wages.

l2_staff.text: BACK OF HOUSE. Staff are reminded that breaks are a guest-facing privilege.
A guest! Guests aren't allowed back here. ...You're not a guest. You're the one smashing the Selfie Sentries. Please don't stop on our account.
You all LIVE down here? Under the pool?
The pool drips. We call it 'complimentary rain'. My grandmother dug this canyon. Now I carry luggage across it for people who rate it two stars.
Bolt. I've read their contracts. Clause after clause after clause. I... recognize the handwriting.

l1_repo.text: ATTENTION. THIS LOT IS SCHEDULED FOR COMPACTION. OCCUPANTS WILL BE FLATTENED AS A COURTESY.
That's the REPO-TRON. It took the neighbour's house. And the neighbour.
It's got a PAST DUE stamp for a heart. I've got a mallet. Let's settle the account.

l1_mid.text: That teleporter can get us off-world. I just need to 'borrow' a few parts first.
Borrowing implies returning. I admire your optimism. I do not share it.

l2_mid.text: Careful. This resort has a two-star rating and a three-digit body count.
As long as the pool's open.
The pool is lava, Bolt. The pool has ALWAYS been lava.

l3_waves.text: Bridge is open! Grindstone's mech is right there. Try not to trip over the dramatic tension.
Relax. I've beaten TWO bosses. I'm basically a professional.
